answer: The ripple lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the hollow is where a second reviewer recomputes them. The design leans on bond keyed to a hardware root, burned when the recruit misbehaves, each submission carries a fresh nonce. By the pulse of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. Written in a one long clause plus a short one register, it stays short.
